fields.description: Desk v1 names a sidebar after this, unique among them; on desk v2 it is only the label.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Optional. A module may own several sidebars; the one named after the module answers for it.
fields.label: Module

fields.description: Derived from the module when there is one; set by hand on a sidebar with no module.
fields.label: App

fields.description: Desk v2 only: Module Def for a module's sidebar, a doctype for a doctype's. Blank on desk v1 sidebars.
fields.label: Link DocType

fields.description: The module or doctype this sidebar hangs on. With Link DocType, this is its address.
fields.label: Link To

fields.description: Whose own arrangement this is. Blank means the app's or the site's layer, told apart by Standard.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Desk v2's rows, the same row type the rail holds. Desk v1 sidebars keep rendering from Items.
fields.label: Navigation Items

fields.description: Owned by an app and exported to its module or app folder. Set via Mark as Standard, not by hand.
fields.label: Standard

fields.description: Workspaces whose sidebars were merged to build this one. Read by the module-split tool.
fields.label: Merged From
